headword: {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A type of Japanese small-business corporation in which the owners' liability is limited to their investment. New {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} cannot be founded since the 2006 Companies Act, but existing ones continue to operate and the name is still common in business listings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father runs a limited liability company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社名|しゃめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The business card had the name of a limited liability company on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Because the law changed, it is no longer possible to newly establish a limited liability company.

notes:
Often abbreviated ⟦{有限|ゆうげん}→有限：29338_yuugen⟧ or written as ㈲ before the company name. The 2006 Companies Act ({会社法|かいしゃほう}) discontinued the category, but existing {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} were grandfathered in and may still keep the title indefinitely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish a limited company
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run a limited company
- {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}{○○|まるまる}: "○○ Ltd." (in company names)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧: stock company; joint-stock corporation — much larger and more common form, with shares
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}: LLC (Japanese-style) — the modern small-business form that replaced {有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ} after 2006
